jobs.title: Director of Business Systems Product Management
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management.

We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation , more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.

You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries.

About the Role

This role leads the Business Systems Product team in the CIO organization.

Verkada runs on four value streams — Quote-to-Cash, Attract-to-Hire-to-Retire, Procure-to-Pay, and Record-to-Report. The systems behind them decide how fast the company can sell, hire, source, ship, and close the books. You own the product functions across them.

The portfolio spans both sides of the company. Some of these systems face partners and customers, where the experience is part of how Verkada competes and where the ambition is to be the easiest company in the industry to do business with. Others face employees, where the experience drives how the company scales. The bar is the same on both sides: systems people choose to use, intuitive enough to need almost no training, and scalable so overall company growth exceeds the rate of headcount growth.

Your team is organized by the functions it serves: Partner Ecosystem (Partner Portal and vStore), Finance, Supply Chain & Operations, Legal, and People. Each product manager owns the systems roadmap for their function and acts as the product counterpart to that function's leadership. You own the whole — including the parts that only work when someone connects them. A partner order has to land cleanly in NetSuite. A headcount plan has to reconcile between Workday and the financial model.

This is a fully onsite role in our San Mateo HQ

What You'll Do

- Build streamlined features for pricing configurations, automated approvals, checkout, payments, and fund requests (MDF/JSF) to enable partners to operate without manual intervention.

- Recruit and coach 6–10 PMs to write strong requirements, manage roadmaps, and serve as strategic partners to business leaders.

- Drive product strategy, architecture, and roadmap for all enterprise business systems to support scalable, public-company growth. Lead a team of 6–10 PMs and analysts across key operational domains.

- Define the systems roadmap, lead make-vs-buy decisions, manage total cost of ownership (TCO), and establish a standardized intake process for all business requests.

- Partner Ecosystem & vStore: Build and scale self-service portal for quoting, deal registration, order management, and billing.

- Finance: Oversee NetSuite order-to-cash and financial close systems.

- Supply Chain: Manage inventory, order processing, logistics, and contract manufacturer integrations.

- Legal & People: Automate employee lifecycle systems and identity/access provisioning.

- Build SOX-ready controls, auditability, and data warehouse integrations to public-company standards.

What You Bring

- Bachelor's degree in MIS, CS, Finance, Business, or another technical/analytical field.

- 10+ years in product management, business systems, or a related technical role, including 3+ years leading product managers. Experience managing managers is a plus.

- Track record owning enterprise systems end to end across more than one business function, accountable for the outcome rather than the delivery alone.

- Experience across both external-facing and internal-facing systems, and a clear point of view on why the quality bar should be the same for both.

- Experience designing for multiple personas on a shared surface, where a seller, an admin, and a finance user all need the product to work without it becoming a compromise for all three.

- Depth in at least two of: quote-to-cash, record-to-report, procure-to-pay, supply chain planning and fulfillment, or the employee lifecycle — with credible curiosity about the rest.

- Hands-on experience with Salesforce, NetSuite, Workday, or comparable platforms, and with the integration patterns that connect them.

- Basic SQL, Python, JavaScript and HTML. You should be able to interrogate the data yourself.

- Solid understanding of UI/UX principles and experience partnering with design. You can review a wireframe and tell the difference between a workflow that gets adopted and one that gets worked around.

- Experience preparing and delivering to executive leadership, including defending a roadmap and a make-versus-buy recommendation.

- An ideal candidate handles ambiguity, moves fast, and builds alignment across a demanding stakeholder group — keeping leadership informed and bought in along the way.

Employee Benefits

- Healthcare programs that can be tailored to meet the personal health and financial well-being needs - Premiums are 100% covered for the employee under at least one plan and 80% for family premiums under all plans

- Nationwide medical, vision and dental coverage

- Health Saving Account (HSA) with annual employer contributions and Flexible Spending Account (FSA) with tax saving options

- Expanded mental health support

- Paid parental leave policy & fertility benefits

- Time off to relax and recharge through our paid holidays, firmwide extended holidays, flexible PTO and personal sick time

- Professional development stipend

- Wellness/fitness benefits

- Healthy lunches provided daily

- Commuter benefits

Additional Information

Annual Pay Range

With that in mind, we carefully consider a number of factors to determine the appropriate starting pay for an employee, including their primary work location and an assessment of a candidate's skills and experience, as well as market demands and internal parity. A Verkada employee may be eligible for additional forms of compensation, depending on their role, including sales incentives, discretionary bonuses, and/or equity in the company in the form of restricted stock units (RSUs)

About the Role

This position sits on the Business Systems Product team in the CIO organization.

Verkada sells through partners. Two products carry that motion: the Verkada Store (vStore) , where partners quote, price, and order, and the Partner Portal , where partners run their Verkada business — registering deals, tracking orders and renewals, pulling pricebooks and inventory, requesting marketing funds, and reaching the training and enablement they need to sell. You own both. One partner experience, two surfaces.

Verkada's ambition is to be the easiest company in the industry to do business with, and the Store and the Portal are where that promise is either kept or broken. The bar is a system partners choose to use: intuitive enough to need almost no training, useful enough that nobody keeps a side spreadsheet, and scalable enough that order volume can grow faster than the supporting headcount growth.

This is a build role. vStore is homegrown and in active development, and partner self-service ordering is one of the company's primary levers to scale revenue without scaling headcount. You will own the roadmap end to end with a dedicated engineering team. Executives, Sales, Marketing, and Finance are all invested in these products, so success depends as much on building alignment as on shipping.

We are committed to a thriving in-office culture. This role requires you to be onsite at our HQ in San Mateo, CA.

- Build streamlined features for pricing configurations, automated approvals, checkout, payments, and fund requests (MDF/JSF) to enable partners to operate without manual intervention.

- Take full ownership of strategy, prioritization, PRDs, and user experience for both core partner platforms, from quote-to-order pathways to navigation and identity management.

- Hold both products to a product standard, not an internal-tool standard. The honest measure is whether a partner would rather use the Store than call someone, and whether an internal user would rather use it than build a workaround.

- Partner with Sales, Channel, Marketing, Finance, Supply Chain, and Deal Desk to translate needs into features and workflow changes across the full partner journey.

- Talk to partners directly. Partner AEs, SEs, order admins, and finance admins each use these products differently, and the roadmap should reflect what they do, not what internal stakeholders assume they do.

- Lead cross-functional requirements sessions to define functional scope. Surface the unspoken and conflicting requirements, and drive to a decision.

- Directly impact key operational metrics—including board-level targets for self-service order adoption, reduced quote cycle times, straight-through order processing, and support ticket deflection across key partner personas.

- Recommend changes to development and system standards that improve scalability and reduce maintenance burden.

What You Bring

- Bachelor's degree in MIS, CS, Business, or other technical/analytical field.

- Minimum 5+ years of experience, ideally including e-commerce, retail systems, or online storefront management.

- Basic SQL, Python, JavaScript and HTML preferred.

- Experience with marketplace platforms, channel programs, and multi-channel selling.

- Familiarity with CPQ and quote-to-cash, discounting, payment processing, checkout flows, and order management systems.

- Familiarity with pricing strategy concepts (e.g., tiered/volume pricing, promotions, bundling) and how they translate into system configuration.

- Experience designing for multiple personas in a single product, where the same surface has to serve a seller, an admin, and a finance user without becoming a compromise for all three.

Who We Are

Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management.

We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation , more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.

The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries.

About the Role

As the founding Product Marketing Manager for Privacy and Data Security, you will play a central role in advancing Verkada’s core mission to protect people and places in a privacy-sensitive way by defining and driving our global privacy and data security narrative. These elements are never afterthoughts at Verkada; they are foundational to how we design our technology and a core differentiator that enables us to earn the trust of – and successfully sell to – some of the world’s largest organizations.

In this role, you will lead the charge in proactively establishing Verkada as the undisputed leader in how a cloud-first physical security company should approach privacy and data security. You will go incredibly deep into the weeds of our technical architecture, becoming a subject matter expert who can be strategically deployed to create customer-facing collateral, go toe-to-toe with technical experts and executive buyers, and evangelize our privacy and security posture across the entire go-to-market engine.

This role is deeply cross-functional and requires you to bring together stakeholders across the Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, and Communications teams. You will also partner closely with Verkada’s Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) and Chief Privacy Officer. This role will report into our Director of Product Marketing.

We are open to hiring at the Manager or Senior Manager level, depending on the candidate’s experience and qualifications.

We are committed to a thriving in-office culture. This role requires that you be on-site at our HQ in San Mateo, CA 5 days a week.

What You'll Do

- Hone Verkada’s privacy and security narrative: Clearly articulate how Verkada differentiates itself, our fundamental approach to data protection, and how these practices deliver value to our customers. Refine and adapt our messaging and positioning strategies in response to product developments, competitor movements, and public sentiment.

- Drive proactive privacy thought leadership and asset creation: Author, advise on, and elevate high-impact collateral – including technical whitepapers, one-pagers, blogs, videos, and sales decks – to position Verkada as the definitive authority in the space. Take complete ownership of the Verkada Trust Hub webpage, significantly expanding its depth to turn it into a comprehensive, best-in-class destination for public transparency.

- Serve as a cross-functional subject matter expert: Act as a definitive expert on data privacy across our product portfolio. Unite Marketing, Sales, and Product teams to drive commercial results, lead Executive Briefing Center (EBC) sessions, and directly empower our field organization to navigate complex technical privacy evaluations.

- Enable the go-to-market engine: Partner closely with Sales, Demand Generation, Creative, and Channel Marketing teams to accelerate pipeline growth. Translate complex hardware capabilities and technical privacy frameworks into high-impact outbound marketing assets and field collateral that directly improve win rates.

What You Bring

- 4-8 years of product marketing experience in B2B technology or IoT

- Exceptional writing skills with meticulous attention to detail and ability to write content for a variety of audiences, including highly technical content

- Extreme curiosity and desire to dive deep into the weeds of all things privacy and enterprise data security. Even if you do not have a technical background, you are excited to spend hours learning the intricacies of Verkada’s architecture so you can feel confident speaking with highly technical buyers

- Self-directed and able to operate independently in a fast-paced environment

- Experience working cross-functionally with teams including Product, Communications, Sales, Demand Generation, and Creative

- Bachelor’s degree required

Employee Benefits

Verkada is committed to fostering a workplace environment that prioritizes the holistic health and wellbeing of our employees and their families by offering comprehensive wellness perks, benefits, and resources. Our benefits and perks programs include, but are not limited to:

- Healthcare programs that can be tailored to meet the personal health and financial well-being needs - Premiums are 100% covered for the employee under at least one plan and 80% for family premiums under all plans

- Health Saving Account (HSA) with annual employer contributions and Flexible Spending Account (FSA) with tax saving options

- Expanded mental health support

- Paid parental leave policy & fertility benefits

- Time off to relax and recharge through our paid holidays, firmwide extended holidays, flexible PTO and personal sick time

- Professional development stipend
